failure_modes.name: Wheel encoder slip on dusty slab
failure_modes.symptoms: Odometry drift on dusty/uneven concrete; slip during acceleration; inconsistent distance counts
failure_modes.mitigation: Dust-resistant tread; periodic wheel cleaning; fusing odometry with GNSS/IMU; slip-detection filter

failure_modes.name: Laser/optics dust
failure_modes.symptoms: Faint or distorted line projection; misaligned layout marks; reduced beam intensity; scatter haze
failure_modes.mitigation: Sealed optical housing; compressed-air lens purge; daily lens wipe; beam-intensity self-test

failure_modes.name: Battery
failure_modes.symptoms: Reduced runtime; voltage sag under laser+motion load; charge-not-held; unexpected cutoff
failure_modes.mitigation: Cell health monitoring; temperature-managed charging; spare-pack rotation; low-voltage early warning

failure_modes.name: Positioning drift
failure_modes.symptoms: Layout marks offset from true coords; accumulated error over long runs; poor RTK fix indoors
failure_modes.mitigation: RTK base-station tie-in; fiducial re-localization; IMU bias calibration; surveyed checkpoint verification
